arxiv_api_queries.result: No arXiv submission dated May–September 2026 claims a proof or counterexample of the tree/forest unimodality conjecture. Relevant hits in the window: 2605.02193 (dominating sets, off-topic), 2607.08480 (cites conjecture as open).

web_search_queries: Alavi Malde Schwenk Erdős conjecture proof
own_computations: Verified p_{r-1} <= r p_r for all r <= i(T) (independent domination number) on all trees with n <= 12 via exact DP; the inequality can fail for larger r.

Verified r p_r^2 + p_{r-1}^2 - (r+1) p_{r-1} p_{r+1} >= 0 on all trees with n <= 12 and on all 1,228 LC-failure polynomials in Reynolds' n<=32 census; no failures found. Neither inequality was found stated under any name in the literature.
